actions.confirmStopBody: The VM will shut down. You can start it again later — disk data is preserved.

actions.terminateNoSnapshot: No snapshot of this instance exists in our cache. If you need its disk later, take a snapshot first.
actions.terminateOldSnapshot: Most recent matching snapshot is {days}d old. Consider snapshotting first.

codai.title: codai environment
codai.description: Make this VM a codai Environment: installs the codaid daemon over SSH and enrols it (BYO, free).
codai.hint: Nothing is linked yet. Provisioning installs codaid, which only opens an outbound WebSocket to relay.codai.ro — no inbound ports.
codai.notConfigured: Add a codai API key first so Vatra can create the environment for you.
codai.unsupported: codaid's installer runs on Linux and macOS guests only.
codai.copyCommandHint: Mints a fresh one-time enrol token (30 min) and copies the installer one-liner — paste it into the VM if the automatic install failed.
codai.unlinkConfirm: Unlink this VM from its codai environment?
codai.unlinkHint: Only Vatra forgets the link. The environment and the daemon on the VM are untouched; manage them from codai.
codai.projectHint: Reuse an existing project or create one.
codai.whatHappens: Vatra will create the environment in codai, mint a one-time token, run the codaid installer on the VM over SSH (needs sudo for /usr/local/bin and systemd) and wait up to 5 minutes for the daemon to enrol.
